messages:
maria: Quick intake — new candidate model 'theta-7b-raw' landed in the model catalog. Requesting quantization plan + bring-up checklist. Primarily targetting Redwood Dedicated first, then Hosted if perf/cost looks good. @aj @ken can you weigh in on int8 vs fp8 tradeoffs for this arch?
aj: Ack. Can you drop quick baseline perf/size numbers and expected sequence lengths?
maria: Baselines: unquantized float32: 28GB GPU memory for 2048 context, 1.9 tokens/ms on A100. Typical request seq len 256 avg, 1024 max. Throughput target: 1200 concurrent QPS across a Dedicated pool.
ken: Got it. For theta-7b, int8 (PTQ) usually saves ~2.8x memory and has minor (<1-2%) quality drop on common NLU tasks, but generative tasks can regress more. fp8 (Apex/FP8) gives ~1.7-2x memory and better quality than int8 but requires supported hardware/kernels.
sylvia: Priority guidance: customer projects X and Y want lower cost first; customer Z needs SLOs for generation quality. Suggest two parallel tracks: (A) aggressive cost path: int8 gguf/PTQ; (B) quality-preserving: fp8 or quant-aware training (QAT) as fallback.
maria: Sounds good. Can we sketch a short checklist for bring-up + quant calibration steps? Keep it scannable so SRE/devex can follow.
aj: I'll draft. High level: 1) Sanity & safety checks, 2) Model packaging (gguf/transformer-weights), 3) Quant calibration + eval harness, 4) Perf validation + kernel selection, 5) Rollout.
ken: Add: automated regression tests tied to eval prompts and perplexity/LM score baselines. Also a small human eval for subjective generations.
aj: Putting a quick checklist here: 
```
- Pre-onboard: verify license & provenance; compute flops/params; smoke-load run float32
- Packaging: produce gguf and TorchScript artifacts; include tokenizer + vocab
- PTQ (int8) path:
  - run representative calibration dataset (500-2k sequences)
  - try symmetric vs asymmetric scales
  - measure per-layer activation outliers
  - export int8 gguf and run evals
- FP8 path:
  - check device kernel availability (A100s with FP8 libs or H100)
  - run FP8 quant harness, compare to float32 on NLU/generation
- QAT fallback: small-lr fine-tune on 10-20k steps if regressions >3% on key metrics
- Eval: token-level perplexity, BLEU/ROUGE where applicable, and a ranked prompt set for quality regressions
- Perf: measure peak memory, steady-state throughput at seq=256 and 1024; latency p95/p99
- Safety: run toxics/PII filters; ensure logits calibration for sampling
- Rollout: canary at 1% traffic -> 10% -> 100% with auto-fallback on QoS regressions
- Docs: include quant config JSON and tuning notes
```
maria: Nice. For calibration dataset: can we reuse the 'prod-cali-2025' set? It has mix of chat/generated and NLU pairs.
ken: Yes, good starting point. For int8 PTQ we should include long-tail prompts (lots of rare tokens) to surface outlier ranges. Also log activation ranges to S3 for later analysis.
sylvia: Cost estimate request: can aj pull expected cost reduction numbers for Dedicated pool if we deploy int8 vs fp8? Need rough % for sales decks.
aj: Will run cost model: ballpark memory reduction -> more GPUs per pod -> cost drop. I'll post numbers by EOD.
quant-bot: Ticket created: INF-4821 "theta-7b: quant plan intake" assigned to @aj, @ken; due 2026-03-20.
maria: Quick question on gguf: do we plan to publish gguf artifacts in model catalog for Hosted after Dedicated validation?
ken: Prefer to hold off gguf public until we validate safety/regressions; we can publish an internal preview for partners.
maria: Ok. One more: devex needs a small config snippet that toggles per-model quant policy. Example?
aj: Example policy JSON: 
```
{
  "model": "theta-7b",
  "quant_policy": {
    "preferred_format": ["fp8","int8"],
    "fallback": "float32",
    "calibration_samples": 1000,
    "outlier_clip": 0.995
  }
}
```
ken: We'll add recommended values to the repo. Also flag: int8 gguf can sometimes break streaming token consistency; include tests for deterministic sampling.
maria: Great. Next steps: @aj generate cost numbers + draft PR with packaging steps; @ken run initial PTQ runs and post top-5 regression diffs; @sylvia I'll sync with customer success re: priorities.
aj: On it. I’ll add perf numbers and cost delta to INF-4821.
sylvia: I'll notify sales and list customers for early access.
ken: I’ll push initial eval artifacts to s3://redwood-evals/theta-7b/ptq_v1/ and post logs here when ready.
maria: Thanks everyone. Tagging this thread for the incubator board. :seedling:
quant-bot: INF-4821 status updated: PTQ job queued (job id q-9003).
